title: Phase 4: fee conversion and context source
goal: Hoàn tất Week 4 theo `TP-PLAN`: thêm nguồn public market bar deterministic cho local harness, third-asset fee conversion có provenance, ContextSnapshot ENTRY/EXIT point-in-time và no-lookahead validation.
nonGoals: Không gọi Binance network thật trong test hoặc yêu cầu credential; Phase 4 local harness dùng deterministic public market-bar ingest để freeze adapter/provenance contract.
Không triển khai authenticated exchange API, account sync, signed/user-data/trading endpoints, raw market-data redistribution hoặc generic market browser.
Không triển khai Episode Review, metric engine đầy đủ, dashboard drill-down, Weekly Lab, export/deletion hoặc AI của Phase 5+.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Domain/application contracts có exact literals `mce-binance-spot-v1.0.0`, `mce-default-v1`, `market_bar_as_of_v1` và records cho MarketConversionCatalogVersion, MarketDataIngestionBatch, MarketDataSourceRequest, MarketBarRevision, MarketBarSourceObservation, ContextAlgorithmRelease, ContextEpisodeTrigger, ManualContextRecomputeRequest, ContextSnapshot; `FeeConversionRecord` mở rộng market-bar provenance mà vẫn giữ Phase 3 exact/null cases.

Third-asset fee conversion dùng public 1m bar point-in-time: direct `fee_asset+USDT` ưu tiên inverse `USDT+fee_asset`, chỉ dùng bar có `barEndExclusive <= fill.source_time_start` và cách fill không quá 5 phút, persist DERIVED method/rate/value/asOf/bar+observation arrays/path; missing/stale/unresolved giữ `UNAVAILABLE` và không dùng future/current substitution.

Local market-data source lưu public tenant-free provenance immutable cho batch/request/observation/bar revision, canonical source base URL/hash, pagination/cache dedup và revision conflict surface tối thiểu; global public rows không chứa workspace/user/episode ID và không tạo TenantExternalOperationLease.

Context control có registered `CONTEXT` work type, immutable ContextAlgorithmRelease allowlist, ContextEpisodeTrigger cho ENTRY sequence 1 và EXIT sequence N, ManualContextRecomputeRequest idempotent/conflict-safe, và validation reject wrong release/trigger/request hash, wrong phase/timeframe/sequence hoặc cross-workspace projection trước enqueue.

ContextSnapshot publisher tạo immutable ENTRY/EXIT snapshots cho 1m/5m từ active episode projection, dùng only selected bars có `barEndExclusive <= asOfAt`, input/provenance hash ổn định, quality/aggregation eligibility rõ ràng, và published snapshot không đổi khi thêm future bars sau `asOfAt`.

Phase 4 API/UI/migration/tests/verifier/local CI/CHANGELOG được cập nhật; Phase 0/1/2/3 checks vẫn xanh, secret/bin-obj guard không báo lỗi, và UI/API không thêm exchange API key/private sync/live sync/generic browser hoặc ngôn ngữ signal bị cấm.

validationPlan.description: Đọc lại TP-PLAN Week 4, TP-MCE output/source/control/no-lookahead và TP-ACC fee-conversion provenance trước khi edit.
Chạy C# harness Phase 4 để chứng minh third-asset direct/inverse conversion, public market provenance, context control, ContextSnapshot và no-lookahead behavior.
Kiểm artifact Phase 4: migration/schema literals, API/UI surface, verifier, CHANGELOG, CI wiring và prohibited market/signal surface.
Chạy local CI Phase 4 gồm restore/build, Phase 0/1/2/3/4 runners, verifiers và secret/bin-obj scan.

evidence.summary: RED: Phase 4 build failed because MarketBarInput and related market/context contracts did not exist yet.

TP-PLAN/TP-MCE/TP-ACC scope review pass: Phase 4 bounded to deterministic public market source, third-asset fee conversion provenance, context control, immutable ContextSnapshot and no-lookahead checks; network/live sync and Phase 5+ remain out of scope.

C# Phase 4 harness pass: third-asset direct/inverse conversion uses point-in-time bars, public market provenance is tenant-free, context triggers use ENTRY 1 and EXIT N, manual retry is idempotent/conflict-safe, and snapshots ignore future bars.
tools/verify-phase4.ps1 pass for Phase 4 schema literals, migration, app surface, API/UI context controls, tests, CI wiring, changelog and prohibited market/signal surface scan.
tools/test-phase4.ps1 pass: restore/build, Phase 0/1/2/3/4 runners, Phase 0/1/2/3/4 verifiers and secret/bin-obj guard all passed.
